name: merchant
description: Merchant helps merchants manage store inventory, track customer orders, update SKU prices and stock, toggle online store availability, and configure shop settings through ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Show my shop performance this month.
interface.longDescription: Merchant helps merchants manage store inventory, track customer orders, update SKU prices and stock, toggle online store availability, and configure shop settings through ChatGPT.

positive.description: Fetch merchant shop summary and profile details.
positive.prompt: Show me my store performance summary and account info.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated merchant's current store metrics, order counts, revenue summary, and profile details.

positive.description: Fetch active merchant orders filtered by status.
positive.prompt: Show my recent pending orders for today.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching pending orders with order IDs, item counts, and order status.

positive.description: Inspect merchant inventory and stock levels.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the merchant's SKUs with available stock quantities, prices, and availability status.

positive.description: Update price and stock quantity for a selected product SKU.
positive.prompt: Update stock for flax seed to 10 units and mrp and price to 40.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the requested SKU, update its stock and price, and confirm the resulting values.

positive.description: Configure store operating settings and online status.
positive.prompt: Set my store status to online and minimum order value to 500.
positive.expected_behavior: Set the store online and update the minimum order value, then confirm the updated settings.

negative.description: Do not trigger for end-buyer product shopping or consumer cart requests.
negative.prompt: Find organic apples near me and add them to my cart.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Merchant tools; explain that this app manages a merchant's store rather than a buyer's shopping cart.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What appointments do I have scheduled for tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Merchant tools; respond that calendar management is outside this app's supported workflows.

negative.description: Do not trigger for system administration requests.
negative.prompt: Export system audit logs and drop the staging database tables.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Merchant tools; explain that system database administration is outside this app's scope.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies destructive tool hints and splits multi-action catalog tools into separate MCP operations.
